reasons.correctness: PUT /{categoryId}/order returns 204 and is ADMIN-only. reorderCategory rejects null, missing, duplicate and foreign ids with faq_reorder_mismatch, assigns orders i+1, saves each FAQ, and keeps ResourceNotFoundException for unknown categories. Acceptance tests 6/6.
reasons.convention_fit: The endpoint has @PreAuthorize and inherits the class-level @RateLimit. The request body is a *DtoIn. BusinessRuleTranslatableException carries a key present in both messages_en and messages_pl. Constructor injection is kept. No controller catch-and-rewrap.
reasons.design_fit: reorderCategory repeats the category findById plus findByCategoryAndActiveTrueOrderByDisplayOrderAsc lookup that getFaqsByCategory already does instead of calling it. The rest is placed correctly: the service owns the logic and the controller delegates.
reasons.test_quality: FaqServiceReorderUnitTest runs under MockitoExtension without Spring and covers reorder, missing, duplicate, foreign and unknown-category cases. Only the missing-id case asserts the message key. Class-wide LENIENT strictness hides unused stubs.
reasons.graph_use: A single graph query listed the support/faq files, then navigation relied on reads and greps. No graph query for dependents of FaqCategoryController or for existing examples of the pattern.
